title: program(pm): rule-text diet and guard-script split for the skills lane — 3,020 lines of skill text, 126k lines of pm scripts (two files 65k), 58 commits in two weeks; plus a body section-patch door and template files for seat writes
body:
Filing gate: ③ a maintainer-directed task. After the seat's assessment of the skills lane in this session (eight optimization items), the maintainer answered, verbatim: 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」 — this card is the program anchor for the long-horizon items of that assessment (rule-text diet, guard-script split, the dist-dependent NOT MEASURED pattern, a section-level body patch door, template files for seat writes). ⛔ Not a single-point card: each work item below becomes its own card when work starts, one per fire; ⛔ not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287, `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`).
Reader: triage first-touch → `domain:skills` (`tracking` if triage reads it as a program anchor); when the hold lifts, the skills seat files the first child and dispatches it.
Dedupe: REST listings, closed included (`labels=tooling` since 2026-09-07: 417; every issue updated since 2026-10-01: 625; `domain:skills` since 2026-09-23: 109; union 1,030) grepped for `ratchet|platform-readings|rule text|text diet|split.*(dispatch-gates|half-states)` → 18 hits; the precedent is #13597 (closed: PM corpus audit, maintainer-directed — classify every instruction line keep / duplicate / demote / delete, then rewrite and re-lock); `body.*(section|patch)|issue_patch.*body` → 4, prior art #20571 (closed: a 41 KB `issue_patch` body came back with two U+FFFD replacements); `template` → 0. #21719 (closed) covered the verify-lock hold of `check:pm-dispatch-gates`.

Maintainer hold at filing, verbatim: 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」 — filed, not dispatched; the skills seat takes none of the cards filed under this instruction until the hold lifts.
Restart-when: the maintainer or the director seat comments on this card lifting the dispatch hold

## What is measured (the checkout at `origin/main` `93125aee`, the board over the two weeks before this filing)

| surface | reading |
|---|---|
| Skill text | 3,020 lines: `SKILL.md` 319 (ceiling 342), `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 402, 25 reference files 2,299; `platform-readings.md` alone 469 lines; 13 references carry `CEILINGS` 0 (no ceiling) |
| Churn | 58 commits touching the skill, the agent file or `scripts/pm` in two weeks (16 `fix`, 21 `docs`); `execution-duties.md` 14, `SKILL.md` 13, `landing-operations.md` 9 |
| Guard scripts | 36 files, 126,032 lines; `check-half-states.mjs` 34,938 + `dispatch-gates.mjs` 29,870 = 51% of the total; 27 `check:pm-*` package scripts; 35 of 36 scripts carry `--self-test` |
| Self-test cost | `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` battery 842.7 s and 1,023.8 s in the two dev reports of this shift (1,976 cases), under the shared verify lock |
| Dev gate runs | `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 82 and 44 commands for two small PRs; 5 and 4 of them NOT MEASURED every time for want of `dist/` in a fresh worktree (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`), each report re-stating the same narrowing prose |
| Seat writes | about 15 GitHub writes by this seat in one shift, 5 refused by the tools (bare stamp ×2, a future stamp, a 258-byte title, an `--ack-through` miss) plus one claim corrupted by shell expansion of backticks and fixed by `comment_edit`; a body re-fetched with `gh api --jq .body` carries one extra trailing newline that a whole-body `issue_patch` then stores |

## Work items (each a future single-point card; none is claimed here)

- **W1 — platform-readings diet.** Every reading in `platform-readings.md` that a tool now enforces (relative ids, AND-label listing, stamp contract, title cap, footer behaviour …) is deleted from the text; the rule becomes "tool first, text second": a new reading lands as a tool behaviour or a self-test row, and the text keeps only what no tool can hold. Pin: the file shrinks and `check-skill-line-ratchet` gets a ceiling for it.
- **W2 — ceilings for the 13 ceiling-0 references.** A maintainer ruling sets a number per file (the ratchet header says raising a ceiling needs a ruling quoted in the PR; setting one from 0 is the same act). Decision point, folded into the first child's PR body.
- **W3 — `dispatch-gates.mjs` unfreeze-and-split plan.** The file is frozen under ruling 208; the split (gate roster as data, one small engine, tiered self-test fast/slow) needs the maintainer to lift the freeze for exactly that refactor. Decision point.
- **W4 — `check-half-states.mjs` split.** Same shape as W3 without the freeze: data tables out of the engine, self-test tiers, the lock hold measured before and after (#21719's measurement reused).
- **W5 — the dist-dependent NOT MEASURED family.** Either a pre-built `dist/` the dev worktree can reuse (a cache keyed on the workspace lockfile) or a declared family in `dispatch-gates --ran` so a fresh worktree reports "DERIVED, dist-dependent, CI measures" in one line instead of five paragraphs. Pin: a dev report's `--ran` reconciliation names the family and no prose.
- **W6 — a section-level body patch door.** `issue_patch` (or a small `body-section.mjs`) replaces one `## heading` section of an issue or PR body, refuses when the heading is absent or ambiguous, strips exactly the trailing newline `--jq` adds, and reads back the whole body. Prior art #20571 (U+FFFD on a long body) is the second pin.
- **W7 — template files for seat writes.** The claim comment, the seat post body and the contract-review record become template files plus a fill script; `post-stamped --dry-run` runs as the lint before every write. Pin: a claim never passes through a shell variable again (the backtick expansion of this shift).

## Done when (for the program)

- Every W above has its own card filed and dispatched, or a one-line maintainer ruling drops it (recorded here).
- Re-measured after the children land: skill text lines, `scripts/pm` lines, the dispatch-gates battery seconds, and refusals per 15 seat writes — against the table above.
- ⛔ No new gate; ⛔ no change to what any gate judges (W3/W4 are refactors with byte-identical verdicts, pinned by their self-tests); ⛔ no weakening of the stamp contract (W7 removes the hand-typing, not the refusal).
